messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
During the periodic verification of the P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17, must the employer show the results of a supplementary investigation?

response.text: Durante la verifica periodica della gru mobile P&H R200 in posizione 17, il datore di lavoro deve esibire i risultati di un accertamento integrativo?
